title: LiveErrorBody
description: The body of every error answer of the live HTTP routes (ADR 0002's error shape, closed). 429 answers carry Retry-After (seconds).

error.description: POST /api/live/sessions: 401 invalid_token, token_unknown, token_expired or token_revoked (the device token), 409 sessions_full (3 per account). POST /api/live/controller: 403 cannot_control, for every failure. POST /api/live/control: 403 invalid_code (unknown session or wrong code), 409 controllers_full. Any route: 422 invalid_request, 429 too_many_requests, 500 internal_error.
